text:
Lina (Community): Heads-up: we've cut adapter-stable v2.0.0 and are hosting a Community Extensions Demo Day next Mon 5pm PT. RSVP + demo signups: https://events.redwood.ai/extensions-demo (limited slots). Please share with maintainers and integrators! :tada:

Owen (Engineering): Congrats! Is v2.0.0 a major bump with breaking changes?

Lina (Community): It's a major release but we kept breaking changes minimal. Top-level release notes below (copy/paste friendly).

Harpreet (Maintainer): Can you include a short migration snippet so we can update the README and CHANGELOG?

Lina (Community): Sure — pasteable bullets and snippets below:

```
adapter-stable v2.0.0
- new: unified adapter API (Adapter v2) with async streaming support
- new: plugin metadata (capabilities, trust-level) for registry listing
- perf: improved KV-cache locality for lower tail latency
- fix: safe shutdown path to flush KV cache on node drain
- docs: migration guide from v1.x + example upgrade scripts
```

```bash
# upgrade
npm install @redwood/adapter-stable@^2.0.0
# minimal code change (sync -> async)
await adapter.send({ input: 'hello' })
```

Carmen (Docs): I'll add the migration guide and the minimal code snippet to the README. Harpreet, do you want me to open the PR for the changelog?

Harpreet (Maintainer): Yes please. Also adding a small compatibility table for older runtimes.

Theo (DevRel): For Demo Day I'm reserving 5 slots (7min demo + 5min Q&A). Maintainers can demo adapter integrations or registry flows. Please attach a screenshot or a short gif. I'll also draft a forum post and social copy.

Owen (Engineering): Note for demos hitting Dedicated: include p95 and throughput, and whether you used the new async streaming path. Ops can provide a sample dashboard if needed.

Lina (Community): We'll also host a maintainer office hour Thu 9am PT to help with the migration and demo prep. Demo signups on the event page include a checkbox for "need Ops screenshot".

release-bot: Automated release: adapter-stable v2.0.0 published by @lina. Changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/adapter-stable/compare/v1.4.8...v2.0.0. CI: all checks passed. :robot_face:

Harpreet (Maintainer): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/adapter-stable/pull/890 with changelog + migration doc. Carmen, ping me if you want any wording tweaks.

Theo (DevRel): Copy. I'll schedule the promo and add a demo template: "what it connects to / user flow / p95 / screenshot link".

Lina (Community): Awesome — thank you everyone! If maintainers need help with upgrade scripts or demo assets, drop into the office hour or DM me. :rocket:
